blocks.content: Congratulations! You've built a fully functional Whack-a-Mole game with complete game flow—start screen, gameplay, timer, scoring, and end screen. Everything works!
But right now, it looks pretty basic. The holes are brown circles, the moles are simple colored divs, and the overall design could use some polish.
This chapter is all about taking your working game and making it look and feel professional. Small visual improvements make a huge difference in how players experience your game!
By the end of this chapter, you'll have:

items: Real mole images that look great
Smooth animations when moles are hit
A game you're proud to show off!
